description: Changes cells of one row in the person's own track, when they correct something ("that burrito was 750 calories, not 600"): read_rows first for the row's number and values, then give values (each column to its new value) and was (each of those columns to the value read_rows showed), so a row that changed since isn't overwritten. Values are checked like added rows'. Only change what the person asked to; don't add a second row for a correction.

values.description: Column name (as read_rows shows it) to its new value.

was.description: The same columns, to the values read_rows showed in them.

name: update_row
title: Correct a row
